seo.title: SUP board advisor — which board suits you? | [APPNAME]
seo.description: Answer a few questions (weight, experience, water type, goal) and get a personalized SUP board recommendation with prices and reviews.

wizard.title: Board advisor
wizard.lead: Five quick questions — and we'll show you which board fits you.

passenger.q: Will you take a passenger along?
passenger.hint: With an adult companion your COMBINED weight matters — we estimate about 70 kg. If your companion is much heavier, add the difference to your own weight.

water.q: Where will you paddle most often?

use.q: What will you mainly use it for?

error.invalidWeight: Enter your body weight between 30 and 200 kg to continue.
error.invalidHeight: Enter your height between 120 and 220 cm.

height.hint: Weight determines the board's volume (buoyancy), height its length — a taller paddler suits a longer board.

result.title: Your boards
result.empty: We didn't find a board for these criteria — try loosening the budget or storage filter.
result.noReviews: No reviews for this board yet.
result.ratingAria: Common ground: {{value}} out of 10 from {{count}} reviews
result.sizing: For your profile a board around {{length}} cm ({{feet}}) long, {{width}} cm wide and ~{{volume}} litres is ideal — we ranked by these.

noMatch.noBoards: There are no boards in the catalog right now.
noMatch.type: No board type in the range matches the chosen use. Try another use.
noMatch.availability: Boards matching your criteria are not currently available in Hungary.
noMatch.storage: Nothing matched with the “inflatable only” constraint — allow rigid boards as well.
noMatch.maxLoad: The load you entered (body weight + passenger) exceeds the capacity of the boards in range. This is a SAFETY limit, not one to relax — look for a high-capacity, extra-wide board, or drop the passenger.
noMatch.volume: The boards in range have too little volume for the weight you entered — you need a larger, higher-volume board.
noMatch.budget: No suitable board under your budget — try raising it.

reason.volume: The {{volume}} l volume gives comfortable headroom at {{level}} level.
reason.stability: Wide, stable board — confident for a {{level}} paddler.
reason.maxLoad: The {{maxLoad}} kg load capacity easily handles the {{effWeight}} kg load.
reason.value: Good value: {{price}} Ft within your range.
reason.length: {{length}} cm long — for your profile about {{ideal}} cm is ideal.
